thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: service=inference-api-eu metric=p95/p99 latency SLO burn=72% over 10m — esc level=page -> @sam
sam: Acked the page, joining now. quick check: is this across all routes?
maya: I see p99 ~3.2s on /v1/generate, p95 ~1.1s. embeddings OK. Region: eu-west.
leo: Logs show a ton of KV cache evictions around 1733333270 and a flurry of sidecar restarts. Might be a hotkey + batch size spike.
sam: Hmm. Autoscaler didn't spin up new replicas — the metric looks pinned at 80% mem for the pool. Can someone grab autoscaler logs and controller events?
leo: running: ```kubectl -n inference get hpa inference-eu -o yaml && kubectl -n inference logs deploy/autoscaler --since=15m``` seeing backoff errors and rate limit 429s from cloud provider on scale requests.
maya: Possible provider-side throttling. If autoscaler can't scale, fallback needed. Suggest routing traffic to dedicated-pool-burst or swap to quantized-model-v2 to reduce token time.
sam: Agreed. Temporarily rerouting slow routes to dedicated-pool-burst. @pagerduty-bot please suppress duplicate pages for 10m while we triage (we'll still update thread).
pagerduty-bot: Suppression request received. Duplicate paging suppressed for 10 minutes.
leo: I've kicked an emergency route change: /v1/generate -> dedicated-pool-burst (canary 10%). Monitoring latency.
maya: Canary looks promising — p95 dropped to 600ms on canary hosts. Rolling to 50%.
sam: Noting customer impact: small percentage of requests experienced >2s tail. No widespread errors, mostly degraded latency. Filing short customer note after postmortem.
leo: Also started warming KV cache on old nodes to reduce cold miss penalty.
maya: FYI found a recent rollout (deploy@1733333100) that changed batcher heuristics. Reverting that patch for eu cluster now.
sam: Good catch. Revert in progress. Keeping suppression until we confirm stabilization. If metrics hold for 15m, we'll close page.
incident-bot: Quiet window policy: automated pages suppressed while manual ack active. Remind: update runbook link https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-evict-latency
sam: Handing off in 25m to next oncall (maya). Leaving notes: - autoscaler rate-limit to provider; ask infra to request quota bump - consider throttling batch size for noisy keys - evaluate autoscaler retry/backoff.
maya: Taking the handoff. I'll watch the 15m stabilization window and follow up with infra.
sam: Thanks — marking as acknowledged and monitoring. Will update when stable. :thumbsup:
